errors.text_span: 图表中共有四组柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart shows five groups of bars, corresponding to Test1 through Test5, not four.

errors.text_span: 其他依次为黄色（约 24%）、深绿色（约 23.5%）和蓝色（约 23%）
errors.evidence: In Test1, the ordering of the bars by height after the green one is incorrect. The blue bar (i-vector, ~24.5%) is higher than the yellow bar (d-vector, ~23.5%), but the description lists yellow before blue.

errors.text_span: 在 Test3 中，绿色柱最高（约 24%）
errors.evidence: In Test3, the yellow bar (d-vector) is the highest at approximately 25%, not the green bar (无) which is at about 24.5%.
In Test4, the description incorrectly states that the blue bar is higher than the yellow bar. The image shows the yellow bar (d-vector, ~22.5%) is visibly taller than the blue bar (i-vector, ~21.5%).

errors.text_span: 整体来看，绿色柱在所有测试集中均为最高
errors.evidence: This generalization is incorrect. As seen in Test3, the yellow bar (d-vector) is higher than the green bar (无).
